name: Vértesacsa (Hungary)
description: A vertical pale yellow banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vértesacsa: a red and blue shield with a sickle, a tree, a church and a plough, below a scroll inscribed VÉRTESACSA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
